title: Create accessibility evidence bundle and guidance for color-vision modes, keyboard focus mapping, and interactive legends
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Audit findings and deliverables to produce a reproducible accessibility evidence bundle for interactive legends, button and table focus behaviors, and color-vision simulation assets. Deliverables: 1) consolidated evidence zip (screenshots, axe reports, test matrix) for compliance reviewers, 2) design guidance for color-vision modes (protanopia/deuteranopia/tritanopia) and token alternatives, 3) keyboard focus mapping and accessible role patterns for legend and table row interactions, 4) follow-up engineering tasks (ARIA updates, token fallback variables, Storybook tests).
comments: 2026-02-12: Initial exploratory audit completed across 18 components (buttons, compact tables, charts with legends). Found inconsistent focus ring density and 3 distinct legend interaction patterns that break keyboard discoverability.

2026-02-18: Design decision: standardize on a high-contrast focus token (focus-ring-strong) and a secondary focus for dense modes. Kept token variables rather than hard-coded values to preserve theme parity.

2026-02-25: Trade-off discussed with Eng: using 4.5:1 for primary UI text vs 3:1 for non-interactive labels to avoid visual regression in compact charts. Agreement: prioritize interactive controls (buttons, legend toggles) at 4.5:1 and provide non-interactive reduced-contrast token mappings for labels.
2026-03-02: Created color-vision simulation assets and test plan (Protanopia, Deuteranopia, Tritanopia) for automated visual diffing in Chromatic; prototype screenshots attached in evidence bundle.
2026-03-06: PR opened to update ARIA roles for chart legends and to add aria-pressed/aria-checked patterns for toggleable legend items. GH PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pulls/7321

2026-03-09: Accessibility QA notes — keyboard mapping: use arrow/space/enter patterns for legend navigation; ensure escape closes legend popovers and returns focus to triggering control. Observed focus trap in table compact row actions; assigned Eng follow-up.

2026-03-12: Packaged evidence bundle: screenshots (light/dark + three color-vision sims), Axe-core reports (v4.6), Storybook accessibility snapshots, and a condensed one-page guidance PDF for compliance reviewers. Upload link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aXb-example-evidence
